lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
knorke-main: 7 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 7 B.
css holds 1 stylesheet, 214,251 B, and no page of this build loads any of them: no entry in js is named after one, and none is reached from an entry that is.
Each is loaded from PHP or built into the bundle, so none is left without a loader. Where the build writes its stylesheets somewhere else, --css=DIR names that directory.
846,911 B in 5 pieces of 4 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (38 packages, 400 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js is left without something that loads it.
